question: top Avocado Oil brands companies Kenya
markdown:
Kenya's top avocado oil companies include [⁠Olivado EPZ Limited](https://agrifichallengefund.org/olivado-epz-limited/) (the global leader), [⁠Avoprokenya](https://avoprokenya.com/), Limbua, Croft's Limited, and [⁠Fairoils](https://fairoils.com/products/avocado/). These processors utilize Kenya’s abundant Hass and Fuerte crops to supply international food, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical markets. [](https://www.tiktok.com/@mainawaavocado/video/7637766244980002055)

-   **Olivado EPZ Limited:** Produces a massive share of the world's organic extra virgin avocado oil from Murang'a, working with thousands of smallholder farmers. [](https://www.facebook.com/kenyangrown/videos/olivado-epz-adding-value-to-avocado-fruit/259593179005711/)

-   **Avoprokenya:** Focuses on pure, additive-free cold-pressed extra virgin and crude avocado oils sourced from a large local farming network.

-   **Limbua:** Operates decentralized organic processing facilities near Mount Kenya, ensuring fair-trade and fully traceable organic fruit value chains.

-   **Croft's Limited:** Partners with smallholders to manufacture export-grade extra virgin avocado oil primarily from mature Hass avocados.

-   **Fairoils:** Manages sustainable agricultural sourcing and production Fairoils of natural plant extracts and edible oils.

-   **Additional Industry References:** You can research broader trade data and manufacturers through [⁠Export Genius](https://www.exportgenius.in/kenya-importers-of-avocado-oil) or evaluate shipment volumes via [⁠Volza](https://www.volza.com/p/avocado-or-oil/manufacturers/manufacturers-in-kenya/).
